steps.observation: One of the most basic approaches to evaluate a sentence encoder is to measure the classification performance with the sentence representations made by the encoder. Thus, we conduct experiments on the following five datasets. (Summary statistics for the datasets are reported in the supplemental materials.) MR: A group of movie reviews with binary (positive / negative) classes. BIBREF22 SST-2: Stanford Sentiment Treebank BIBREF6 . Similar to MR, but each review is provided in the form of a binary parse tree whose nodes are annotated with numeric sentiment values. For SST-2, we only consider binary (positive / negative) classes. SST-5: Identical to SST-2, but the reviews are grouped into fine-grained (very negative, negative, neutral, positive, very positive) classes. SUBJ: Sentences grouped as being either subjective or objective (binary classes). BIBREF23
